title: Humanity was born way ahead of its time. The reason is grabby aliens.
summary: Rational Animations explains Robin Hanson's grabby aliens model, which argues that humanity looks suspiciously early in cosmic history. Expanding civilizations set a deadline that explains our timing and bears on the Fermi paradox.
why: Recommended as a short explanation of a non-intuitive anthropic reasoning argument.

quote.text: This 12 minute video does a good job of explaining the fairly non intuitive reasoning
